# What this notebook does

It carries out the analysis fixed in `docs/prespecification.md`, on the 314 **holdout** chats, using the LLM ratings in `data/llm_ratings_long.csv`.
Deviations from the pre-specification are listed at the end (section 9).
Results describe *observable reasoning and effort in chat transcripts, as rated by LLMs*. They are not measures of learning or of learner engagement, and LLM agreement shows consistency, not validity.

# 1. Data

```{r data}
holdout <- fromJSON("data/holdout_ids.json")
dev     <- fromJSON("data/dev_subset_ids.json")

chats <- readRDS("analysis/data/processed/chats.rds") %>% filter(user_id != 1)
chat_info <- chats %>%
  group_by(chat_id) %>%
  summarise(
    student = first(user_id),
    arm     = first(treatment_tutor_id),
    school  = first(location),
    start   = min(created_at),
    n_msgs  = sum(role == "user"),
    n_words = sum(words[role == "user"], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(student) %>%
  mutate(chat_order = rank(start, ties.method = "first")) %>%   # proxy for task (see 9)
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    arm = factor(arm, levels = c("non_socratic", "socratic")),
    log_msgs = log(n_msgs), log_words = log1p(n_words)
  )

ratings <- read_csv("data/llm_ratings_long.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    rubric = sub("__.*", "", rater),
    mode   = ifelse(student_only, "student_only", "full")
  )

stopifnot(setequal(unique(ratings$chat_id), holdout))
cat("Holdout chats:", length(holdout), "| students:", n_distinct(chat_info$student[chat_info$chat_id %in% holdout]), "\n")
chat_info %>% filter(chat_id %in% holdout) %>% count(arm) %>% kable(caption = "Holdout chats by arm")
```

# 2. Reliability gate (pre-specified, section 3)

```{r reliability}
rel <- read_csv("data/reliability_holdout/reliability_table.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  transmute(
    rubric = sub("rate_", "", prompt), mode = ifelse(mode == "student", "student_only", mode),
    item = dimension, n = n_chats,
    alpha = alpha_between_models, spearman, pct_agree, ac1
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    binary = !is.na(pct_agree),
    pass = ifelse(binary, pct_agree >= 80 & ac1 >= 0.60, alpha >= 0.67),
    status = ifelse(pass, "primary", "exploratory")
  )
rel %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2))) %>% kable(caption = "Between-rater agreement on the holdout (pass = pre-specified threshold)")
status_full <- rel %>% filter(mode == "full") %>% select(rubric, item, status)
```

Items that fail are shown below but labelled **exploratory** and are not used for headline claims.

# 3. Outcome construction

Each rater's scores are z-scored within rubric × mode × item over all rated chats; the item score is the mean of the two raters' z-scores.
`question_asking` is the mean of the two binary ratings (0, 0.5, 1).

```{r outcomes}
primary_items <- c(
  student = "reasoning_quality", student = "knowledge_building",
  student = "effort_seriousness", student = "question_asking",
  socratic = "supportive_guidance", socratic = "next_step_guidance",
  socratic = "encouraging_tone", socratic = "conversational_flow"
)
items <- tibble(rubric = names(primary_items), item = unname(primary_items)) %>%
  mutate(family = ifelse(rubric == "student", "A: student behaviour", "B: Socratic conduct"))

```

```{r outcomes2}
long <- ratings %>%
  mutate(rubric = sub("rate_", "", rubric)) %>%
  rename(item = dimension) %>%
  semi_join(items, by = c("rubric", "item")) %>%
  group_by(rubric, mode, item, model) %>%
  mutate(z = ifelse(item == "question_asking", score, as.numeric(scale(score)))) %>%
  ungroup()

outcome <- long %>%
  group_by(chat_id, rubric, mode, item) %>%
  summarise(y = mean(z, na.rm = TRUE), n_raters = sum(!is.na(z)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(chat_info, by = "chat_id")

outcome %>% filter(mode == "full") %>% count(rubric, item, n_raters) %>% kable(caption = "Raters per chat and item")
```

## Descriptives by arm

```{r desc}
desc <- outcome %>% filter(mode == "full") %>%
  group_by(rubric, item, arm) %>% summarise(mean = mean(y), sd = sd(y), n = n(), .groups = "drop")
ggplot(outcome %>% filter(mode == "full"), aes(arm, y, fill = arm)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = .4, colour = NA) + stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 2.5) +
  facet_wrap(~item, scales = "free_y", nrow = 2) + guides(fill = "none") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Item score (z, mean of two raters)", title = "Ratings by arm (holdout, full dialogue)")
messages <- chat_info %>% filter(chat_id %in% holdout) %>% group_by(arm) %>%
  summarise(median_student_msgs = median(n_msgs), median_student_words = median(n_words), chats = n())
kable(messages, caption = "Interaction volume by arm (the mechanical confound)")
```

# 4. Primary models

`score ~ arm + school + chat_order [+ log(messages) + log(1+words)] + (1 | student)`, linear mixed model, Satterthwaite p-values.
**Primary specification = adjusted for interaction volume**; the unadjusted model is shown for comparison.
Benjamini–Hochberg correction within each family (4 tests each), applied to the adjusted model.

```{r models}
fit_item <- function(d, adjusted) {
  f <- if (adjusted) y ~ arm + school + chat_order + log_msgs + log_words + (1 | student)
       else y ~ arm + school + chat_order + (1 | student)
  m <- lmer(f, d, REML = TRUE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))
  cf <- summary(m)$coefficients["armsocratic", ]
  ci <- suppressMessages(confint(m, "armsocratic", method = "Wald"))
  tibble(est = cf["Estimate"], se = cf["Std. Error"], p = cf["Pr(>|t|)"],
         lo = ci[1], hi = ci[2], n = nobs(m), students = n_groups(m))
}
n_groups <- function(m) lme4::ngrps(m)[["student"]]

run_all <- function(data, mode_sel = "full", label = "primary") {
  data %>% filter(mode == mode_sel) %>%
    group_by(rubric, item) %>% group_modify(~ bind_rows(
      mutate(fit_item(.x, FALSE), spec = "unadjusted"),
      mutate(fit_item(.x, TRUE),  spec = "adjusted"))) %>%
    ungroup() %>% mutate(analysis = label)
}

res <- run_all(outcome %>% filter(chat_id %in% holdout)) %>%
  left_join(items, by = c("rubric", "item")) %>%
  group_by(family, spec) %>% mutate(p_bh = p.adjust(p, "BH")) %>% ungroup() %>%
  left_join(status_full, by = c("rubric", "item"))

res %>% mutate(across(c(est, se, lo, hi), ~ round(.x, 2)), p = signif(p, 2), p_bh = signif(p_bh, 2)) %>%
  arrange(family, item, spec) %>%
  select(family, item, status, spec, est, lo, hi, p, p_bh, n) %>%
  kable(caption = "Socratic vs non-Socratic (reference). Estimates in z units (question_asking: proportion units).")
```

```{r forest, fig.height=6}
ggplot(res, aes(est, reorder(item, est), colour = spec, shape = status)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, colour = "grey50") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi), position = position_dodge(.5)) +
  facet_grid(family ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Socratic − non-Socratic (z; 95% CI)", y = NULL, colour = NULL, shape = "Reliability",
       title = "Unadjusted vs adjusted for message and word counts")
```

# 5. Robustness: each rater separately (sensitivity 2)

```{r raters}
per_rater <- long %>% filter(mode == "full") %>%
  mutate(y = z) %>% left_join(chat_info, by = "chat_id") %>% filter(chat_id %in% holdout) %>%
  group_by(rubric, item, model) %>% group_modify(~ fit_item(.x, TRUE)) %>% ungroup()
per_rater %>% mutate(across(c(est, se, lo, hi), ~ round(.x, 2)), p = signif(p, 2)) %>%
  select(item, model, est, lo, hi, p) %>% arrange(item, model) %>%
  kable(caption = "Adjusted model, one rater at a time")
```

# 6. Sensitivity analyses

```{r sens}
adj <- function(d, label) run_all(d, "full", label) %>% filter(spec == "adjusted")

# 4. exclude single-message chats
s4 <- adj(outcome %>% filter(chat_id %in% holdout, n_msgs > 1), "excl. 1-message chats")

# 1. student-only ratings (student rubric only; pre-specified sensitivity)
so <- run_all(outcome %>% filter(chat_id %in% holdout, rubric == "student"), "student_only", "student-only ratings") %>%
  filter(spec == "adjusted")
```

```{r sens5}
# 5. all 354 chats: add dev-subset ratings made with the same frozen prompts and raters
dev_long <- read_csv("data/llm_ratings_dev_v3_long.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(rep == 1, !student_only) %>%
  mutate(rubric = sub("^rate_", "", sub("__.*", "", rater)), mode = "full")
hash_ok <- ratings %>% distinct(rubric, prompt_hash) %>% mutate(rubric = sub("rate_", "", rubric)) %>%
  inner_join(dev_long %>% distinct(rubric, prompt_hash), by = c("rubric", "prompt_hash"))
cat("Prompt hashes identical between dev and holdout runs for:", paste(unique(hash_ok$rubric), collapse = ", "), "\n")

pair_ok <- bind_rows(
  tibble(rubric = "student",  model = c("gpt-4o-mini", "claude-haiku-5-5")),
  tibble(rubric = "socratic", model = c("claude-haiku-5-5", "gpt-4o")))
dev_long <- dev_long %>% rename(item = dimension) %>%
  semi_join(pair_ok, by = c("rubric", "model")) %>%
  semi_join(hash_ok, by = c("rubric", "prompt_hash")) %>%
  semi_join(items, by = c("rubric", "item"))

all_long <- bind_rows(long %>% filter(mode == "full") %>% select(chat_id, rubric, mode, item, model, score),
                      dev_long %>% select(chat_id, rubric, mode, item, model, score)) %>%
  group_by(rubric, item, model) %>%
  mutate(z = ifelse(item == "question_asking", score, as.numeric(scale(score)))) %>% ungroup()
outcome_all <- all_long %>% group_by(chat_id, rubric, mode, item) %>%
  summarise(y = mean(z, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>% left_join(chat_info, by = "chat_id")
s5 <- adj(outcome_all, "all 354 chats")
cat("Chats in the all-chats sample:", n_distinct(outcome_all$chat_id), "\n")
```

```{r sens-table}
sens <- bind_rows(res %>% filter(spec == "adjusted") %>% mutate(analysis = "primary (holdout 314)"),
                  s4, so, s5) %>%
  select(analysis, rubric, item, est, lo, hi, p, n)
sens %>% mutate(across(c(est, lo, hi), ~ round(.x, 2)), p = signif(p, 2)) %>%
  arrange(item, analysis) %>% kable(caption = "Adjusted Socratic − non-Socratic effect across pre-specified sensitivity analyses")

ggplot(sens, aes(est, analysis)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, colour = "grey50") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi)) + facet_wrap(~item, scales = "free_x", nrow = 2) +
  labs(x = "Socratic − non-Socratic (95% CI)", y = NULL)
```

Sensitivity 3 (truncate every chat to its first 3 student messages) is **not run**: it needs the LLM to re-rate the truncated transcripts, which is a separate step.

# 7. Does the rating carry information beyond interaction volume? (sensitivity 6)

```{r length}
r2_marginal <- function(m) {
  vf <- var(as.vector(model.matrix(m) %*% fixef(m)))
  vr <- sum(sapply(VarCorr(m), function(x) as.numeric(x)))
  ve <- sigma(m)^2
  vf / (vf + vr + ve)
}
len_tab <- outcome %>% filter(mode == "full", chat_id %in% holdout) %>%
  group_by(rubric, item) %>% group_modify(~ {
    d <- .x
    m_len <- lmer(y ~ school + chat_order + log_msgs + log_words + (1 | student), d, REML = FALSE)
    m_arm <- update(m_len, . ~ . + arm)
    tibble(R2_length_only = r2_marginal(m_len), R2_length_plus_arm = r2_marginal(m_arm),
           LRT_p_arm_given_length = anova(m_len, m_arm)[["Pr(>Chisq)"]][2])
  }) %>% ungroup()
len_tab %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(.x, 2))) %>%
  kable(caption = "Marginal R² (fixed effects) and likelihood-ratio test for arm after accounting for length")
```

# 8. Interpretation

```{r interp, results="asis"}
f <- res %>% filter(spec == "adjusted") %>% mutate(sig = p_bh < .05)
u <- res %>% filter(spec == "unadjusted") %>% select(item, est_u = est, p_u = p)
fu <- left_join(f, u, by = "item")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(fu))) {
  r <- fu[i, ]
  cat(sprintf("- **%s** (%s): adjusted effect %+.2f [%.2f, %.2f], BH-p = %.3g; unadjusted %+.2f (p = %.3g). %s\n",
              r$item, r$status, r$est, r$lo, r$hi, r$p_bh, r$est_u, r$p_u,
              ifelse(r$status == "exploratory", "*Exploratory (failed reliability criterion).*", "")))
}
```

*Read with*: the unadjusted contrast is partly mechanical, because the Socratic prompt requires students to reply (median student messages by arm shown in section 3).
The adjusted estimate removes the part explained by the number and length of student messages, and is the pre-specified headline.

# 9. Deviations and caveats

```{r dev, results="asis"}
cat("- No task identifier is available in the chat data; **chat order within student** is used as the pre-specified proxy for task.\n")
cat("- Sensitivity analysis 3 (first-3-message truncation) is not run here (needs re-rating).\n")
cat("- The Socratic items failed the pre-specified reliability criterion and are exploratory.\n")
cat("- `question_asking` failed the 80%-agreement criterion and is exploratory.\n")
cat("- `effort_seriousness` has alpha = 0.6695, just below the pre-specified 0.67 threshold, and is therefore exploratory; the rule was applied to the unrounded value.\n")
cat("- `knowledge_building` is significant only marginally after BH correction (p = 0.0496) and is not significant for the Claude rater alone (section 5).\n")
cat("- Primary specification, family definitions, multiple-testing rule and reliability thresholds are unchanged from `docs/prespecification.md`.\n")
```
